question_pt: Quando houver cadastro de município do hospital, quais pares de estado de residência e estado do hospital tiveram maior volume de internações interestaduais?
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT mr."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios mr ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mr."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE regexp_full_match(mr."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND regexp_full_match(mh."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$')) SELECT uf_residencia, uf_hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM base WHERE uf_residencia <> uf_hospital GROUP BY uf_residencia, uf_hospital ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10
